$Comment: The long sitting before the greater table: forty pieces unmade and Enchanting level twenty,
both on Order 1 so they progress together. Flow.HideLockedSteps keeps the walk back to Orrin
off the step list until that sitting is behind the player, so the quest reads as the work it
long_rites is STATION_INPUT with a blank Target (any piece), qualified to 'Disenchanting_Table'
on PREFIX so both tiers count and the Sawmill does not, carrying the shared unmake_gear
TextKey; reach_the_level is STAT_THRESHOLD, which reads a native stat channel by id
(MMO_Level_ENCHANTING) and holds the high-water reading, so a level already reached counts the
moment the quest is taken. No hand-in: TurnInId 'giver' still settles it at Orrin. Rewards sit
in Claim: Enchanting XP and a handful of Void essence toward the greater table's own ask, the
Name: Steady_Hands
